page: Microsoft Azure NC40ads_H100_v5 is a GPU-accelerated server instance belonging to the NCadsH100v5 family. It features 40 dedicated physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 9V84 processor operating at 3.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 320.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB per core, alongside a single NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPU equipped with 94 GB of VRAM. Local storage consists of 3971 GB of disk space, and the instance is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in several areas. The single-core CPU performance via stress-ng and multi-core Geekbench scores both rank in the top 10%. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and Geekbench image processing also achieve top-tier status. Memory performance is strong, with PassMark memory scores in the top 10% and read-only small block memory bandwidth in the top 25%. However, large-block read-only memory bandwidth and static web serving throughput fall into the average category.

For machine learning workloads, the instance achieves strong text generation speeds of 286.08 tokens per second on small 135M models and 33.22 tokens per second on medium 7B models, though performance drops to an average 3.88 tokens per second on large 70B models. This hardware profile is suited for GPU-accelerated compute tasks, medium-scale language model inference, image processing, and database operations that benefit from dedicated CPU cores and local storage.
